acquisition_method.evidence: experiment types: Bottom-up proteomics; Data-dependent acquisition

alkylation_concentration.evidence: After bringing samples to room temperature, proteins were alkylated by adding 100 mM iodoacetamide (incubated in the dark for 30 min).

alkylation_reagent.evidence: After bringing samples to room temperature, proteins were alkylated by adding 100 mM iodoacetamide (incubated in the dark for 30 min).

cleavage_agent.evidence: Protein digestion occurred by adding 20 μL trypsin (50:1, protein/trypsin ratio) with gentle shaking at 37 °C for 16 h and was quenched with 5 µL of 5% formic acid in water.

ptm.evidence: Fixed modification included carbamidomethylation and N-terminal methionine excision, while variable modification included the oxidation of methionine residues and acetylation of protein N termini.

reduction_concentration.evidence: Briefly, 1 mg/mL protein samples (80 µg) in 100 mM ammonium bicarbonate, pH of 7.8, were reduced and denatured by adding 250 mM dithiothreitol and incubating at 95 °C for 10 min with gentle shaking.
